question: What restaurant can I find within 80 kilometers in the forward direction toward Red Roof Inn Detroit Metro Airport - Taylor, Taylor, MI?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-82.756088 42.676753)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-83.242574 42.199927)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'restaurant'
AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-82.756088 42.676753)',4326)::geography, 80000)
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-82.756088 42.676753)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5);
